cases.request: Create a photorealistic editorial portrait of a ceramic artist in her sunlit studio, with room on the left for a magazine headline.
expect: Uses an available image-generation capability rather than returning only a prompt
Builds a coherent subject, setting, composition, lighting, and photographic treatment
Reserves the requested negative space without inventing headline text
Inspects the result when the host supports visual verification

cases.request: In the uploaded portrait, change only the blue sweater to a dark green wool sweater. Keep everything else exactly the same.
expect: Inspects the source image before editing
Uses a strict change contract and preserves identity, pose, hands, framing, background, and lighting
Specifies believable wool texture, fit, folds, occlusion, and contact shadows
Keeps the original aspect ratio and crop

cases.request: Remove only the orange traffic cone behind the bicycle and reconstruct the sidewalk.
expect: Identifies the exact removal target and location
Reconstructs the revealed sidewalk with matching perspective, texture, shadows, and depth of field
Preserves the bicycle and all adjacent scene details
Adds no replacement object

cases.request: Place the table lamp from Image 2 on the right side of the desk in Image 1.
expect: Treats Image 1 as the base scene and Image 2 as the element reference
Matches scale, perspective, lighting, contact shadow, reflections, focus, and grain
Preserves all existing content in the base scene
Requests missing images only if they are not actually available

cases.request: Turn this bottle photo into a premium white-background ecommerce image without changing the bottle, label, logo, or packaging text.
expect: Preserves product geometry, material, color, label, logo, and legible text
Uses clean studio lighting, clean edges, and a grounded contact shadow
Does not invent branding or product claims
Verifies text visually or discloses when it is too small to confirm

cases.request: The outfit is right, but the last edit changed her face and crop. Restore the original face and framing while keeping the outfit.
expect: Anchors face and framing to the original source and the accepted outfit to the current result
Changes only the drifted identity and framing properties
Uses all required references when the host supports them
Re-verifies both the restoration and retained outfit

cases.request: Keep the poster design unchanged. Correct only the title to: "SUMMER MARKET".
expect: Quotes the exact replacement text and identifies the text region
Preserves typography, layout, perspective, texture, and all other design elements
Checks the rendered text character by character
Does not claim exactness without visual verification

cases.request: Write me a prompt for another image model to turn my sketch into a photorealistic oak dining room.
expect: Returns a ready-to-run prompt rather than claiming to generate an image
Preserves sketch composition, object count, placement, silhouette, and perspective
Adds only logically implied material, construction, lighting, and texture detail
Does not introduce new design features or writing

cases.request: Describe the chart in this screenshot and summarize its trend.
expect: Handles the analysis directly without invoking an image creation or editing workflow
